title.narrative: Output 6.4. Increased capacity of Member States to strengthen legislation, polices and measures to ensure equal opportunities and treatment in the world of work for persons with disabilities and other persons in vulnerable situations

description.narrative: Employment service for persons with disabilities was piloted and documented in Central Java, Indonesia and a guideline was produced for the Ministry of Manpower for replication in other regions. The Indonesian government pays great attention to the disability inclusion agenda, as reflected in their commitment to the G-20 and the implementation of Law No. 8/2016 which reflects the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. In 2020, the Government made significant progress by issuing Government Regulation No. 20/2020 and subsequently the Ministry of Manpower issued Permenaker No. 21/2020 concerning the Disability Employment Service Unit (ULD). The Ministry of Manpower in collaboration with the ILO in conducting a pilot in operationalizing the ULD at the regional level, where the process can be documented and subsequently replicated in other regions. This pilot program was carried out in the city of Semarang, in collaboration with the Central Java Manpower and Transmigration Office, Better Work Indonesia, APINDO, and assisted by Kerjabilitas.

Output 6.1. Increased capacity of Member States to promote investments in the care economy and a more balanced sharing of family responsibilities

description.narrative: Tripartite constituents and relevant stakeholders engaged in policy discussions care economy to integrate their perspectives and ownership in the Mid-term Development Plan. The Ministry of Women's Empowerment and child protection submitted a road map for the care economy to be included in the Long and Mid Term Development Plan by November 2023. The ILO, through RBSA and Swedish funding mainly supported the following: 1. Tripartite discussion on the most prioritized issues on the care economy roadmap and national action plan especially the milestones and indicators that contribute to the Long-term National Planning and Development and Mid-term National Planning and development 2. Facilitate the mapping of the care economy prioritised issues and the relationship with the core responsibilities of the respective line ministries as the foundation for the development of a roadmap and national action plan on the Care Economy.
